神经怎样驱动身体？: How do neurons drive the body?
向前走刺激两侧 LC9 视觉细胞；转向刺激同侧 LC9 和 DNa02 下行细胞: Walking stimulates bilateral LC9 visual cells; turning stimulates LC9 and descending DNa02 on the same side. Input starts at 0.20 seconds and later decays. These are specified stimuli, not a fly seeing a real image.
MaleCNS 提供实测连接。开源 LIF 模型在 166,700 个神经元、2: MaleCNS supplies measured wiring. An open LIF model computes integration, decay and firing across 166,700 neurons and 25,582,938 connections. Bright points are cells that fired in this computation; the afterglow makes them easier to follow.
下行细胞的放电率经过平滑和人工设定的解码器，变成前进速度、转向与步态。六条腿用上: Descending firing rates pass through smoothing and an engineered decoder to set speed, turning and gait. Upstream inverse kinematics solves the six legs. Neural records and body poses share a timeline, replayed at quarter speed.
这一版没有重新训练神经网络。连接权重来自扫描数据，模型参数与动作解码器来自 Ne: No neural network was retrained for this version. Wiring weights come from scans; model parameters and the motion decoder come from Neural Canvas. We used these to compute three recordings offline. These are not measured animal activity and do not include a complete contact, muscle or sensory feedback loop.
网上的魔方、乒乓球与驾驶案例可能另加任务训练、运动解码器和环境反馈，不能把它们都: Cube, table-tennis and driving demos may add task training, motor decoders and environmental feedback. They are not all the same whole-brain simulation. This view presents a traceable neuron-to-body pipeline.
